review_basis: Second byte-bound review of the twenty replacement clips retained by the claim-bound use contract. Decisions use the replacement media SHA-256, twelve-frame contact-sheet SHA-256 and only the narrowed claim/slice roles declared in footage_use_contracts.json.

decisions.reason: The frames show a cargo ship and small boat, not a scientific or offshore working vessel appropriate to the technical expedition context.
A clearly visible ray in bright shallow-looking water is wildlife beauty footage, not a restrained abyssal-plane or deep-seabed context.
The oil tanker creates a petroleum association and cannot represent the rare-earth-mud lifting test or its unfinished production chain.
The frames show people monitoring an interview recording, not operators making technical decisions in an industrial or marine control room.
The reviewed frames clearly show industrial robotics, directly supporting the narration's physical end-use example without carrying any quantitative claim.
The turbines are valid downstream rare-earth end-use context at the single contracted industrial-chain target and are not presented as a mine or Japanese site.
A tropical island aerial cannot carry the long-term persistence of disturbance on a dark deep seabed or a benthic survey context.
The document exchange with lawyers is suitable restrained governance context at the two contracted legal targets; treaty and permit documents retain factual authority.
The reviewed harbor workers and ship provide real human and logistics context for the two contracted strategic-risk targets without identifying a named project.
The industrial metal-processing frames directly support the single contracted refining-bottleneck context while evidence sources carry mineral-specific facts.
The active industrial dock makes material trade and physical supply movement visible at the two contracted concentration and export-control targets.
The tiny leisure-scale boat lacks visible survey equipment or working-vessel context and cannot support the technical-test boundary.
The scientist handling samples is appropriate measurement and baseline-research context at the two contracted targets without impersonating the cited experiment.
A stern view of open water does not show an international assembly or any human governance process required by the contracted target.
The multiple vessels provide a restrained physical metaphor for strategic competition at the two contracted synthesis targets without implying confrontation.
A science-fiction robot on a city rooftop is incompatible with real deep-ocean descent, seabed persistence and the evidence-led visual language.
Scientists discussing at a microscope provide credible unresolved-knowledge context at the single contracted precedent target without naming an institution.
The populated formal meeting is suitable human governance context at the two contracted targets and is never labelled as a named regulator or assembly.
Workers maintaining transport infrastructure give export-control disruption a physical downstream consequence at the single contracted target.
The PPE laboratory team provides valid materials-research context for the single contracted battery-chemistry target without carrying the chemistry evidence itself.
